0022600095.text: The Dallas Mavericks (0-1, 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 1 game back) visit the Indiana Pacers (1-0, 7th in the East and 2nd in the Central) in Dallas's second game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas coming off a loss and Indiana coming off a win. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are all listed as day-to-day. Indiana is without Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), and Aaron Nesmith and T.J. McConnell are listed as day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 134-130 win in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
